items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-09-04
items.q: He'd played with Jimmy Durante when he went to New York.

ctx.x: Somewhere in my notes, I have an article when she died about, maybe in the late 40s she might have died, and I clipped that in the paper. I'll come across that. I don't think I put that in Tulane here anyplace, but we can get the dope on her life a little bit too. But the story, which is probably pretty accurate, because they'd always say, oh, they'd see me taking notes like Gigi Williams. Oh, no, you can't print that. You thought I was writing it up for an article or something. Don't put this down. But she…
They had a colored local, too?
